description: The Postgres settings that can be changed on this instance (timeouts, memory, planner, autovacuum, slow-statement logging), each with its current value, Postgres' default, and the range its plan allows. Durations are in ms and memory in kB; booleans are 1 or 0. `off` is a value outside the range that turns the setting off. `refused` says why they can't be changed right now.

id.description: Instance id, as returned by list_instances

name: get_parameters
title: Read a PostgreSQL database's settings
